messages:
margo: Quick heads-up  the Quickstart 'Cost & latency breakdown' landed a change that shows costs as a decimal per-token (`cost_per_token: 0.0002`) while our SDK snippets and backend expect integer micros (e.g., `cost_per_token_micros: 200`). Playground preview shows costs off by 1000x.

isaac: saw that in CI. which files are failing?

margo: docs/console/observability/costs.md, examples/quickstarts/cost_latency.yaml, snippets/python/cost_example.py, snippets/go/cost_example.go. Linkcheck flagged a bad anchor too.

tess: this came from PR #1424 which aimed to make examples more human-friendly for marketing. Unfortunately it landed in the docs tree. short-term we should: 1) revert examples to use explicit micros, 2) add a migration note with conversion math, 3) add a tiny SDK shim NormalizeCost that accepts float or int and returns micros (deprecated float support).

ci-bot: docs CI failure: example generation error in examples/quickstarts/cost_latency.yaml  schema mismatch (unknown property: cost_per_token). See https://ci.redwood/inference/1424/build/8

isaac: i'll open the SDK helper PR to normalize input and keep snippets working while docs are fixed. will include tests and a TODO to remove float support after 3 releases.

margo: i'll open a docs PR to: - change examples to `cost_per_token_micros: 200` - add migration note: "multiply decimals by 1e6 and round" - include jq and python converter snippets - fix anchor to /sdk/python#cost-helpers

tess: add a short QA checklist: merge SDK PR first so snippet regen doesn't break, then merge docs, regenerate snippets, smoke-test playground quickstart for 30 minutes. If numbers still look off revert docs PR.

margo: draft migration blurb: 

"Migration: Cost unit clarification
Historically examples used fractional token costs (e.g., `cost_per_token: 0.0002`). The Console and SDKs use integer micro-units. Convert by multiplying by 1,000,000: `cost_per_token_micros: int(0.0002 * 1_000_000) => 200`.

# jq converter (example)
jq '(.examples[]|select(has("cost_per_token"))) |= (. + {"cost_per_token_micros": ((.cost_per_token * 1000000)|floor)} | del(.cost_per_token))' old_quickstart.yaml > new_quickstart.yaml

# python one-liner
python -c 'import sys,yaml,json;d=yaml.safe_load(sys.stdin);... print(updated)'

isaac: i'll post the actual SDK PR link once open. plan: sdk PR -> docs PR -> snippet regen -> canary. i'll also add a small deprecation banner in the SDK docs page.

ci-bot: lighthouse: broken anchor found in costs.md to /sdk/go#costhelpers. Suggest updating to /sdk/go/helpers/costs.md.

tess: i'll fix the anchor in the docs PR and add a redirect file for the old anchor.

margo: assignments: margo -> docs PR + migration blurb + anchor fix; isaac -> SDK helper + tests + TODO to remove float support; tess -> snippet regen + playground QA; ci-bot -> run CI and post results. Target timeline: merge SDK helper within today, docs PR within 2 hrs after so snippets remain stable, then 30m canary. :thumbsup:
